mapper.insert: INSERT INTO profit_period_report (shop_id, settlement_id, period_start, period_end, currency, rate_used, rate_missing, order_income, settle_income, settle_commission, fba_fee, other_fee, order_commission, order_profit, diff_income, diff_commission, diff_flag, diff_remark, status) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{settlementId}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, #{currency}, #{rateUsed}, #{rateMissing}, #{orderIncome}, #{settleIncome}, #{settleCommission}, #{fbaFee}, #{otherFee}, #{orderCommission}, #{orderProfit}, #{diffIncome}, #{diffCommission}, #{diffFlag}, #{diffRemark}, #{status}) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE period_start = new.period_start, period_end = new.period_end, currency = new.currency, rate_used = new.rate_used, rate_missing = new.rate_missing, order_income = new.order_income, settle_income = new.settle_income, settle_commission = new.settle_commission, fba_fee = new.fba_fee, other_fee = new.other_fee, order_commission = new.order_commission, order_profit = new.order_profit, diff_income = new.diff_income, diff_commission = new.diff_commission, diff_flag = new.diff_flag, diff_remark = new.diff_remark, status = new.status
